description: Starting assumptions for prototype weighting, not empirically validated reliability estimates. Official operational sources receive a larger prior than unverified reports; all sources remain fallible and conflicts are surfaced explicitly.

decision.assumptions: Initial prototype thresholds, not empirically calibrated or field validated. Low-completeness items below 0.5 are unusable; source reliability weights are documented priors. Recommendation support requires distinct source contribution >= 0.45; repeated claims from one source contribute only its maximum weight. An explicit independent-source marker adds 0.10 per additional independent source, capped at 0.30. Any missing publication availability or unverified unverified_report requires human review; only evidence available by the decision time may support a current recommendation. Forecasts must include the decision time in their validity period.
